CircuitProject.title: CircuitProject
CircuitProject.description: A user-created LogicBench DT-1004 digital trainer circuit project stored in Firestore.

id.description: Unique project identifier matching the document ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the project owner.

description.description: Optional summary description of the circuit.

circuit.description: Structured DT-1004 circuit hardware snapshot (powerOn, switches, clock, pulse, placedICs, wires).

experimentNotes.description: Structured map of experiment observation notes and results.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the project was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the project was last updated.

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}.description: Private per-user collection of LogicBench DT-1004 digital trainer circuit projects.
